title: 5.2.9 Lab: Wind Zone
description: Push the player with applyForce inside a conditional zone. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Add a wind zone
steps.instructions: In draw(), when the player's y position is above the zone line, call applyForce on the player with an upward force so it pushes back against gravity instead of overriding the fall.
hints: Search the moSHion docs drawer for sprite.applyForce.

requirements.title: Use applyForce on the player
requirements.description: The player is pushed with .applyForce(fx, fy) somewhere in the sketch.

requirements.title: Only apply the force inside a zone
requirements.description: The applyForce call is guarded by a conditional (an if with a comparison), not called unconditionally every frame.
